final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT MIN(a.link_to_event) as min_event_id, e.status, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) as distinct_members FROM attendance a JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.status), step2 AS (SELECT status, SUM(distinct_members) as total_distinct_members FROM step1 GROUP BY status), step3 AS (SELECT SUM(total_distinct_members) as grand_total FROM step2) SELECT s2.status, s2.total_distinct_members, CAST(s2.total_distinct_members AS REAL) / s3.grand_total as ratio FROM step2 s2 CROSS JOIN step3 s3 WHERE s3.grand_total IS NOT NULL
